scope.manual: LRM2.4.4 pp78-80, real configured SCDB/GDB files parsed by the original DatabaseFile implementation under the native executor.
scope.namespace: The established port requires explicit imports from spell.runtime, as documented in README/source_port/README and docs/EXECUTOR_COMMAND. Every procedure verifies startup already populated both runtime attributes before importing them and verifies Python builtins remain unchanged. Automatic database loading is demonstrated; implicit injection of SPELL names into ordinary Python globals is not claimed.
scope.ground: Ground dictionary and calibration mappings load as typed original values, including false/empty/nested values, a large integer and UTF-8 text. Original DriverException for absent database keys and TypeError for invalid key objects remain catchable; successful reads recover after failures.
scope.spacecraft: Only Examples135/136/137 are qualified: configured name lookup, keys iteration and the original custom database has_key method. Python built-in dict.has_key compatibility is not inferred.
scope.read_only_gap: DATABASE-SCDB and its broader section stay open: the original DatabaseFile permits local assignment although p79 calls SCDB read-only. No read-only semantics were changed by these two importer patches.
scope.trusted_input: Original trusted database-expression evaluation remains intact. The missing explicit os import caused its namespace construction to fail and silently return raw strings; this patch restores that namespace. Database files are not treated as an untrusted-data sandbox.
scope.distribution: Development overlay with exact original/patched source and native binary identities. Fresh integrated wheel construction and final release qualification remain separate.
